name: Vulcan
reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Rabaul names it only as the second erupting volcano (Understand, Do climb); rule 2 access and any visit unclear.
objection: Case for: active volcano above Rabaul; against: no listing says how to see or climb it, and the Barge Tunnel and Rabaul Tours already bring visitors to its flank.

name: Rabaul Volcano Observatory
reason: Rules 1-4: Wikivoyage See item 6, free lookout with a great view over town, bay and volcano; permanent and open.
objection: Reached by a narrow track and the observatory itself may not admit visitors; only a single counted source, but it is an explicit See listing.

name: Mount Mother
reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Do names the climb (700 m, from Matalau Village, early morning); a real half-day-plus activity.
objection: Case against: one source, no route details, guide probably needed, no coordinates; case for: highest hill around Simpson Harbour.

name: Matupit Island
reason: Rule 1: no counted source; neither Wikivoyage Rabaul nor PNG Tourism East New Britain page names it.
objection: A village island beside Rabaul may be visited on tours, but no visitor source says so.

name: Duke of York Islands
reason: Rule 1: PNG Tourism East New Britain names it (45 min by boat from Kokopo to dive, snorkel, picnic) and Wikivoyage Rabaul lists the trip under Get around; a place, not the boat.
objection: Needs a boat and a tour; the group's tourism is operator-driven.

name: Simpson Harbour
reason: Rule 3: a body of water that is the setting for the Observatory lookout, Tavurvur and the wrecks, not a distinct place to stop; the viewing spots are listed separately.
objection: Wikivoyage calls it spectacular, but the view is already covered by the lookout.

name: Japanese Wrecks, Simpson Harbour
reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Do (dive) names sunken Japanese ships; rule 2 only divers can see them and no single site is pinned.
objection: Case for: a headline reason divers go to Rabaul; against: a dive activity, no specific named wreck or point, operator dependent.

name: Japanese Barge Tunnel
reason: Rules 1-3: Wikivoyage See item 3, enterable tunnel with barges still inside at Karavia, K7 entry; a WWII place visitors go in.
objection: Unmarked turn-off, rough track; part of the wider tunnel network, but this is the one named visitable site.

name: Rabaul WWII Tunnels
reason: Rule 3: near-duplicate of Japanese Barge Tunnel, the only visitable tunnel the sources name; the network itself is not one place.
objection: PNG Tourism recommends touring the barge tunnels and caverns, but that points to the same sites.

name: General Yamamoto's Bunker
reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage See item 4, K5 underground command post; rule 2 visit is short.
objection: Wikivoyage itself says it is small and there's nothing in it; for: a named WWII site that visitors enter, next to the New Guinea Club.

name: New Guinea Club Museum
reason: Rules 1-2: Wikivoyage See item 5, K5 museum in the 1937 club building on Rabaul's history, open to the public.
objection: Opening hours unknown, single source, hot and photo-based displays.

name: Kokopo War and Cultural Museum
reason: Rules 1-2: Wikivoyage See item 7, K10 museum of Japanese war relics in central Kokopo.
objection: Described as a few photographs and trinkets; single source.

name: Bitapaka War Cemetery
reason: Rules 1-3: Wikivoyage See item 2, free AWGC cemetery with a Japanese war memorial at a former seaplane base; a guide-named heritage stop.
objection: A cemetery is a memorial-type site (rule 3 minor memorial); but it is a named See listing with its own access.

name: Kokopo Market
reason: Rule 1: named by Wikivoyage Buy and PNG Tourism ('stroll through the Kokopo markets'); rule 4 trading days not stated in either source.
objection: If it runs most days it is fine; if it is a weekly market it fails.

name: Baining Fire Dancers
reason: Rule 4: a performance or ceremony, not a permanent place; no fixed venue or time.
objection: Two counted sources feature it, but it is an event (Baining Mountains is judged as the place).

name: Baining Mountains
reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage PNG 'The Islands' names the forest, trails, hot springs and mud holes; rule 3 a range, not one point.
objection: For: the one place the fire dance villages and trails sit; against: a range with no single entrance, one source.

name: Pomio
reason: Rule 1: no counted source found; Wikipedia only, and it is an administrative district.
objection: A geographic label with no visitor listing.

name: Nakanai
reason: Rule 3: a cultural area and people, no place; no coordinates, and the masked dances are performances.
objection: PNG Tourism names the masks, but not a place to go.

name: Open Bay
reason: Rule 1: no counted source; Wikipedia only.
objection: WWII history alone is not a visitor listing.

name: Rabaul Submarine Base
reason: Rule 1: no source at all.
objection: The brief named it, but nothing shows it is visitable.

name: Mount Ulawun
reason: Rule 1: PNG Tourism West New Britain names it as one of PNG's most prominent peaks; rule 2 how visitors see or climb it is unstated.
objection: For: 7.6k views and a clear landmark volcano; against: remote, active, no visit details, one source.

name: Mount Pago
reason: Rule 1: no counted source; Wikipedia and an airport article only.
objection: Active volcano, but nothing tells visitors it is a place to go.

name: Garbuna Volcano
reason: Rules 1-2: PNG Tourism West New Britain 'Top activities' lists it as a still-active volcano near Hoskins, popular for trekking and geothermal features.
objection: Single source, no coordinates yet and trekking likely needs a guide.

name: Garu Hot Springs
reason: Rule 1: PNG Tourism West New Britain gives only photo captions (Garu volcanic site, hot springs in Talasea).
objection: For: a natural feature of a district the page tells visitors to visit; against: no description of access or a visit.

name: Lockheed Ventura Wreck
reason: Rule 1: PNG Tourism lists 'Tour the Lockheed Ventura' under top activities; a WWII wreck in Talasea foothills.
objection: For: a named, tourable site; against: single source, remote, no coordinates.

name: Talasea
reason: Rule 3: a district label; its sights (Garu, the Lockheed Ventura) are judged separately.
objection: PNG Tourism says 'Visit the Talasea District', but that is an area, not a stop.

name: Willaumez Peninsula
reason: Rule 1: no counted source; geographic label.
objection: The peninsula holds the real sights, which are judged individually.

name: Lake Dakataua
reason: Rule 1: no counted source for the crater lake; Wikipedia only.
objection: May well be scenic, but no visitor source.

name: Kimbe Bay
reason: Rules 1-3: Wikivoyage Kimbe (900+ fish, 400+ coral species) and PNG Tourism's headline activity; the bay is the place divers and snorkellers come for.
objection: A dive area reached through operators and a large bay rather than a point.

name: Kimbe Town Market
reason: Rule 1: PNG Tourism West New Britain names it for produce and handicrafts; rule 4 trading days not stated.
objection: If daily it qualifies; the source gives no days and the pin is the town centre.

name: Walindi Plantation Resort
reason: Operator and accommodation: a resort is not a spot; the place it serves is Kimbe Bay.
objection: Two counted sources name it, but as a dive operator and lodge.

name: Baia Sportfishing Lodge
reason: Operator and lodge, not a place; fishing is an activity.
objection: Two counted sources name it (PNG Tourism features it), and Wikivoyage's link is dead.

name: Witu Islands
reason: Rule 1: PNG Tourism gives only a photo caption; no description or way to visit.
objection: A remote volcanic group could be a draw, but no source gives a visit.

name: Hoskins
reason: Rule 2: an airport and gateway, nothing to do or see.
objection: Gateway only; its use is in Kimbe's page.

name: Muruk Cave
reason: Rule 1: PNG Tourism names the deepest recorded cave system in the southern hemisphere in the Nakanai area; rule 2 access is expedition caving.
objection: For: a headline natural feature on the official page; against: not a half-hour visit, no coordinates or access details.

name: Numundo Beef Farm
reason: Rule 2: PNG Tourism lists the beef as a food to try; no sign visitors can tour the farm.
objection: A photo caption names the farm; it could be a working plantation with no public access.

name: Gazelle Peninsula
reason: Rule 3: geographic label; no visitor source names it as a place to go.
objection: PNG Tourism says to hire a guide for the Gazelle Peninsula, but its places are judged individually.

name: Kabaira Dive Rabaul
reason: Dive operator, not a place; the dive sites are what could be a spot.
objection: A counted source lists it, but as a business.

name: Rabaul Kokopo Dive
reason: Dive operator, not a place; the dive sites are what could be a spot.
objection: A counted source lists it, but as a business.

name: Kokopo Beach Bungalows Dive Centre
reason: Dive operator, not a place; the dive sites are what could be a spot.
objection: A counted source lists it, but as a business.

name: Rabaul Scenic Tours
reason: Tour operator, not a place; the sights it visits are judged on their own.
objection: A counted source lists it, but as a business.

name: Rabaul Historical Tours
reason: Tour operator, not a place; the sights it visits are judged on their own.
objection: A counted source lists it, but as a business.
